scene.description: TRIM-01-R workpiece (160 x 30 x 20 mm bar, one 8 mm dome at the centre) lying directly on the solid cutting board of blade_master_flat_board_v1, ruler_knife_v2_y tip toward world +y, HOME from the workcell record. tlmpm_v5 law 8 with one cut digit.

goal.description: Remove every protrusion above the base top with near-horizontal surface_trim passes at the C2 rake rho = 10 deg (ADR 0013 decision record), path_v2 controller profile: >= 90% of each protrusion's above-plane reference mass detached, the substrate keeps >= 99% of the below-plane mass, <= 1% below-plane mass detached. Precision is reported separately.

traces.scope: Actual fresh substeps. Read-only selected particle/nearest vertical link observations; counter times include the full episode. Link test uses old/new swept-plane intersection, not a fracture criterion. Impulse is all contacts combined; consumed work is particle cutting work. No historical event is inferred.
